attestations.text: LI Tzŭ-ch'êng 李自成 (original ming 鴻基, later changed to 自晟), Oct. 3, 1605?–1645, notorious free-booter, who took Peking and helped to bring the Ming dynasty to an end, was a native of Mi-chih, Shensi.
